note: What a server sends to say a unit died, to everyone who can see it. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with the death.

fields.name: damageType
fields.note: A client does not read it for this message.

fields.name: damageSource
fields.note: A client does not read it for this message.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long the unit stays down, in seconds. Zero in everything observed.

bits.name: standing
bits.note: Set to leave the unit standing as a husk rather than dead: no time of death, and for a champion no death animation and no death screen. A turret kept after death behaves so whatever this says.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which kill a client announces for killer: zero a neutral monster's, nonzero a minion's.

revisions.note: Where killer names a unit it knows, a client announces the kill for that unit, then the one kind picks. Where the unit is not already dead, it cancels the unit's cast and attack, and only where killer is nonzero puts the unit down, by stayDown and standing.
